tvShow.name: Gogglebox
tvShow.overview: Gogglebox is an entertaining television review programme in which some of Britain's most opinionated and avid telly viewers comment freely on the best and worst television shows of the past week, from the comfort of their sofas.

episodes.name: Celebrity Special for SU2C (2014)
episodes.overview: The Stand Up to Cancer edition of the TV review series, with supermodels Kate Moss and Naomi Campbell, Oasis superstar Noel Gallagher, actress Kathy Burke and comedian Paul O'Grady joining the show's favourite families to share their opinions on what they have been watching during the week.

episodes.name: The Best Bits: 2014 (Series 4)
episodes.overview: A chance to see some of the best moments from the past year of the reality show, featuring the nation's favourite armchair critics. Leon and June, Steph and Dom, Christopher and Stephen, and Sandy and Sandra provide a sharp, insightful and sometimes emotional running commentary on popular TV, from Saturday night entertainment and the soaps, to hard-hitting documentaries and gritty drama.

episodes.name: The Best Bits: 2015 (Series 6)
episodes.overview: Highlights of Britain's favourite viewers and their sharp, insightful, passionate and sometimes emotional critiques of the year's top TV moments.

episodes.name: Brexit
episodes.overview: The Goggleboxers discuss and comment on the fall-out from the EU referendum, from Boris Johnson's new job to Jeremy Corbyn and our new Prime Minister, Theresa May.

episodes.name: Celebrity Special for SU2C (2016)
episodes.overview: Famous faces join the regular TV critics. Plus, Boy George and a very special choir pay tribute to the life and music of David Bowie, Peter Kay has a surprise announcement for The Last Leg boys, there's an appearance from Xtra Factor's Rylan Clark-Neal and Matt Edmondson, and there are appearances by Alesha Dixon and Kimberly Wyatt.

episodes.name: Gogglebox 2017
episodes.overview: Britain's favourite opinionated TV viewers share their sharp, insightful, passionate and sometimes emotional critiques of the year's biggest and best shows, including Strictly Come Dancing, The One Show, The Crystal Maze, Doctor Foster, the Weakest Link Celebrity Special for Children in Need, The Andrew Marr Show, I'm a Celebrity, Mary Berry's Country House Secrets, Naked Attraction and Nigella: At My Table. This is a chance to see some of the best moments of the past year of Gogglebox: 2017 in review from the country's best-loved households, including Leon and June, the Siddiquis, Giles and Mary, Ellie and Izzi, Mary and Marina, and the Tappers.
